title: UI telemetry triage and todo — console ops sync 2026-06-03
content:
Meeting: Console Ops — UI telemetry triage (informal standup)
Date: 2026-06-03 09:30am PT
Attendees: Morgan, Eunice, Diego, Priya, Avery (partial)
Purpose: fast triage of missing UI events, prioritize immediate fixes for next canary, agree short-term observability work to unblock next rollout window.

Summary (TL;DR):
- We found two regressions in telemetry after the recent panel navigation refactor: missing `panel_open` events for deferred panels, and inconsistent `route_latency_ms` tagging for client-side redirects.
- Quick patch landed for panel_open wiring (PR 678) but we need end-to-end verification in staging dashboards + smoke tests.
- Analytics team will add a synthetic test to catch route latency tag mismatch, target merged by 2026-06-07.
- Action items: validation checklist, dashboard alerts, and one small instrumentation pairing session.

Notes / Discussion:
1) Missing `panel_open` for deferred panels
   - Root cause: lazy-loaded panel mounting moved to background scheduler; event emission was tied to mount lifecycle, so deferred mounts never emitted `panel_open` when hydration happened off main thread.
   - Diego: quick fix in PR 678 re-attaches emit to the scheduler callback. Deployed to staging at 2026-06-03 11:10am.
   - Eunice: observed ~40% reduction in hit count for `panel_open` when comparing may/last-week cohort to current canary. Need to backfill? Decided: do not backfill; accept gap but annotate in dashboards.

2) `route_latency_ms` tagging inconsistent across client redirects
   - Problem: measurements recorded on initial route start but client redirects create a second navigation and we fail to update the tag, producing stale/low latency numbers.
   - Priya: will add a middleware to stamp navigation id and ensure final route emits final latency. Pending PR ENG-4190.

3) Dashboard gaps and alerting
   - Current staging dashboard doesn't show `panel_open` volume by panel type; asked observability to add a breakdown.
   - Alert proposal: when `panel_open` volume drops >25% vs 7-day median AND error rate <1%, page on-call and post to #ui-telemetry. (Low false positives.)
   - Avery: will draft the alert rule and smoke-test in staging by 2026-06-05.

4) Canary strategy for next UI rollout
   - Rollout window: 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-12 (internal canary then gradual ramp).
   - Must have: panel_open counts, route_latency finalization, traceable request ids in events. If any of those fail, automatic rollback.
   - Agreement: add a short-circuit fallback in the client to restore previous event path if scheduler-hook fails. Diego to pair with Morgan on that fallback (2 hours).

5) Synthetic test and unit coverage
   - Analytics will add a synthetic that performs: load page -> open 5 panels (deferred + eager) -> perform client redirect -> assert `panel_open` count == 5 and `route_latency_ms` present and >0.
   - Priya estimates work = 1.5d; target merge 2026-06-07.

6) Instrumentation hygiene and schema changes
   - Confluence page: updated schema note to document `navigation_id` field and `panel_type` enum; link in linked_artifacts.
   - Backwards compatibility: events missing `navigation_id` should be treated as legacy; we will not reject but will tag as legacy in the pipeline.

Decisions made
- Roll with non-backfilled `panel_open` gap; annotate dashboards and add alert.
- Require synthetic test and middleware fix before production ramp.
- Implement client fallback to preserve telemetry in worst-case scheduler misfires.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego — pair w/ Morgan to implement client fallback + quick e2e test (2026-06-04)
- Priya — add navigation middleware & open PR ENG-4190 (2026-06-07)
- Eunice — update staging dashboard: panel_open by panel_type and add median comparator widget (2026-06-05)
- Avery — draft and apply alert rule to staging (2026-06-05)
- Analytics team (Priya + Eunice) — implement synthetic smoke test + CI gating (2026-06-07)
- QA — run manual exploratory test on staging after Diego's fallback deployed (2026-06-04)

Open questions / risks
- If fallback adds latency to panel open event emission, will it bias `route_latency_ms`? Need to measure; add microbenchmark.
- How to surface legacy-tagged events to downstream billing/optimization pipelines? Long-term follow-up with data team.

Follow-ups scheduled
- Pairing session: Morgan + Diego — 2026-06-03 2:00pm PT (30m)
- Check-in: quick async update in Slack #ui-telemetry by 2026-06-04 EOD
- Roadblock review: mini-ops standup 2026-06-07 09:00am PT

Useful refs / links
- Telemetry schema (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Telemetry+Schema
- PR (fix panel_open): https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/678
- Jira: ENG-4123 (dashboard gaps), ENG-4190 (navigation middleware)
- Slack thread: slack://channel/ui-telemetry/p149258

Notes to self (rough)
- Keep instrumenting at a small surface to avoid explode-of-telemetry; prefer joins in pipeline vs many fine-grain client events.
- We should prioritize tests that would have caught this earlier (deferred mount path). Add to test backlog.

End notes: good momentum, clear owners. Next formal roundup in weekly ops bulletin; interim updates via #ui-telemetry.
